claims.rationale: The evidence explicitly supports every component of the claim: local access policies reflecting enterprise policy, most-restrictive protection for shared objects, consistent attribute values, lifecycle management by the provisioning organization, documentation of attribute meanings, and procedures for access denials/errors.

The evidence describes the Policy Enforcement Point (PEP), identifies that various data sources provide input to the policy engine, and specifically mentions an 'Industry compliance system' that provides policy rules to ensure regulatory compliance.

The evidence mandates (SHALL) that cookies be HTTPS-only and scoped to minimum hostnames/paths, that channels be authenticated and protected, that sessions not fall back from HTTPS to HTTP, and that OAuth tokens not be interpreted as proof of subscriber presence without other signals.
